[[Captain-in-Chief]] '''Kurakk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who was the leader of the [[Jon-Tow Economic Development Group]], a trading consortium that operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pinett]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Kurakk was middle-aged and Jon-Tow had became embroiled in a trade dispute with a rival concern, the [[Corsignis Property Alliance]].

==Personality and traits==
Kurakk was large for a Trandoshan and he developed a reputation for being both honest and brutal. Over time, Kurakk mellowed and he did not like engaging in the dispute with Corsignis, because of the negative effects that the disagreement had on the inhabitants of Pinett. However, he believed that Jon-Tow could only back down if Corsignis agreed to back off as well.
